retrievalProfile.description: A stark, high-contrast monochrome illustration featuring a central silhouette against a large circular light source, framed by expressive, hand-carved textures and a decorative guilloche-style label.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic black and white composition utilizing heavy ink-like textures, cross-hatching, and negative space to define a figure standing before a massive moon, anchored by a detailed red decorative badge at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure silhouetted against a large circular negative space
Framing elements of organic, scratchy tree limbs creating a natural arch
Horizontal division between a textured sky/ground and a reflective water-like foreground
Contrast between organic hand-drawn lines and a geometric, ornate label
coreInvariants: Strict monochrome palette for the main scene
Heavy use of hatching and cross-hatching for mid-tones
Circular focal point behind the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-full shot of a standing figure, centered horizontally, scaled to occupy the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white circular moon acts as the primary anchor, with the red decorative badge serving as a secondary weighted anchor at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central figure, moves upward to the framing trees, follows the circular moon, and descends to the detailed text badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The moon provides the primary area of negative space, creating a 'halo' effect that defines the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (paper) providing light and form definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red, reserved exclusively for the decorative label at the bottom.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tone grays; all tonal variation is achieved through line density.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single serif family using case and scale to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs match the classical feel.
Provides a traditional, authoritative look suitable for the badge.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white linocut illustration of a man silhouetted against a large white moon, surrounded by scratchy, textured trees and a reflective water foreground. Leave a clear space at the bottom center for a badge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a red ornate guilloche-style badge at the bottom center containing centered serif text in uppercase with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the main image strictly black and white?
Is the texture achieved through hatching rather than gradients?
Is the red badge the only source of color?
Is the text centered and legible within the badge?

postGenerationChecks: Check for linocut-style 'chatter' marks in the black areas.
Ensure the moon is a perfect or near-perfect circle.
Verify the red badge has a distinct, fine-line geometric pattern.
Confirm the figure is fully silhouetted with minimal internal detail.
recipe.reuseFormula: Linocut style + [Subject] + silhouetted against [Light Source] + framed by [Organic Texture] + [Color] decorative label at base.
